# Optional runtime dependency on tree_sitter_python

The test module performs pytest.importorskip('tree_sitter_python') at import time; if that package is not present the tests are skipped. This creates a dependency that can cause tests to be silently skipped in environments missing the package.

- `tests/test_wiki_emitter.py` — `tests.test_wiki_emitter.state`
